_comment: The simulated HPS crate of hpsBldServer (psdaq.sim.simhps): the status registers hps_init reads (psdaq/psdaq/pyhpsbld/pyhpsbld.py) in HpsRoot's tree (pyhpsbld/hpsbld/_Top.py). Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the crate reports. Everything else reads back what was last written (0 if never written).
